answer: One name, one proof, one entry: Notarised porter river licence enforces it, and a licence porters renew after load trials is how the check runs. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Each attempt carries 120 separate visits, each one billed $33 at the door, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. One ferrous, one entry. The copper is checked, not assumed. The pulse is on the docket.
